title: Mixed Event — Rise as One! — Episode7 A Tall Order

meta.Event Outline: On one of his daily runs, Akito has an encounter with a dog and his owner. The pair has been training day by day in the hopes of one day winning a national disc dog competition. But the day before their next competition, this dog owner sprains his ankle...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Wow, you really caught it!
Good boy, Shibao!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
D-Down, Samo!
I know you want a hug! But you're so heavy!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I was wondering what he meant by “more interesting”... They're just having me watch while they toss discs around with their dogs.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I'm less comfortable with this, but it doesn't look too hard...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Alright, Shinonome, why don't we also get started.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'll be throwing the disc.
You watch what Max does, as you have been.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, for this exercise, I'll need you to stand right next to me. Do you think you can do that?

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line:
Sorry, Kamishiro.
I wish I could throw for Max...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's okay. You're injured, and seeing how Max behaves should help me come up with some upgrades for Robo-Dog.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Alright, just watching isn't really an issue...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (And I feel a bit better knowing Max has a kind personality...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (It's not like Max is gonna bite me or anything... But I can't stop myself from flinching...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Looks like we still have some work to do...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I was hoping that you'd feel more comfortable around Max after getting to understand who he is better...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But the sight of a dog charging towards you seems to be at the core of this fear of yours.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means no amount of reasoning is going to help. You just need to get used to being in this situation...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can't say for sure since I'm no expert in this matter.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, I've heard that it takes quite a long time to overcome such past trauma...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I don't have that long...
The competition's tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (But I don't have time to think of another solution either. If brute force and repetition is my only chance, then I've gotta use this time to get over this...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh no!
Shinonome, everyone, I'm sorry!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I didn't mean to throw my disc towards you...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
No...!
Samo's running right towards us!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The disc's going to hit Shinonome!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (A dog's coming this way... My body's frozen up.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Max stepped in front of you, Shinonome...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Is this his way of protecting you...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You really are a nice guy, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry, Shinonome...!
It's all my fault for throwing the disc towards you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Max saved me in the nick of time...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Max is completely different from the dog that chased me around. He's willing to run towards danger to save someone...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Ishihara, mind if I tried petting Max again...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (Start by letting him sniff your hand...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Being chased around by a dog was definitely traumatizing for Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But Max seems to have succeeded in overwriting that memory...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The possibility that he was just going after the disc Hanasato threw remains...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But it doesn't change the fact that he protected Shinonome. This seems to have become the reason he needed to place his trust in Max.

rows.Speaker: Ishihara
rows.Line: In other words, Max's kind and gentle nature helped Shinonome get over his fear of dogs...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Max seems to really enjoy being petted by you, Shinonome.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, look how much he's wagging his tail!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sorry for being so scared of you, Max...
I know you never meant to do anything to me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: This time, I'm going to take the disc back from you.
